services.desc: If you’re looking for something to do in Calgary that’s not the same old thing, an escape room date tends to deliver. You’re doing something together, not just sitting across from each other. You’re figuring things out in real time. And whatever happens in that room, you’ll have a story to tell by the time you leave. There’s something revealing about watching someone solve a puzzle. How they think, what they notice first, whether they go quiet under pressure or get louder - it comes out. Escape rooms are surprisingly good at that.
